topScam.title: The Corporate Tax & MCA Notice Archive Trap (Infostealer ZIP)
topScam.scam: Accountants, CAs, company directors, and finance personnel receive an urgent email or WhatsApp: "Statutory notice regarding pending tax filing discrepancies / MCA audit. Attached: Statement_of_Account.zip or MCA_Notice.zip." Extracting the file runs a disguised Windows executable that quietly exfiltrates corporate net banking tokens, DSC credentials, and browser passwords.
topScam.protection: Tax authorities and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) never send audit notices as compressed .zip or .rar files via WhatsApp or personal email. Check all corporate filings directly on the official mca.gov.in portal.

realityPick.title: The Vector DB RAM Explosion
realityPick.myth: Store billions of high-dimensional vectors in memory for instant enterprise search!
realityPick.reality: Keeping uncompressed 1536-dimensional FP32 vectors in raw server memory costs thousands of dollars per month as document volume scales into the millions.
realityPick.fix: Use disk-backed scalar and product quantization (PQ/SQ) with memory-mapped vector indexes, storing full vectors on NVMe rather than raw RAM.
realityPick.impact: Vector database hosting bills surpass the actual LLM inference bills by 3x at enterprise scale.
